answer: Escrow with a public referral graph blocks bulk fake identities. A newcomer posts 40 credits as a copper deposit, locked 20 epochs, and publishes its sponsor link. Peers split job records like light through a prism, exposing copied outputs. A forged record cracks like a walnut shell under dispute: if upheld, worker and sponsor both lose the escrow. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 credits; an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
